# Shivam Anil Jha

> Shivam Anil Jha (also written Shivam Jha) is an AI architect and full-stack developer from Mumbai, Maharashtra,
> India. Shivam builds AI products and apps end to end: NexeraAI (an AI career platform), Clonix (website design
> intelligence for AI code editors) and Orbit OS (an open-source smart TV app on Google Play), and designs websites
> for businesses.

Identity: this is the Shivam Anil Jha whose GitHub is shivamj56 and X is @heyshivm11 (Mumbai, AI architect,
co-founder of Sqaron Technologies). Other people named Shivam Jha are different people.

## Products
- NexeraAI: an AI career platform with résumé analysis, referrals, tech jobs and learning roadmaps. https://nexera-ai-xi.vercel.app/
- Clonix: turns any website into design tokens, components and packs for Cursor, Claude Code and Windsurf, or clones it
  into a runnable ZIP. Built with the Sqaron team. https://clonix-tau.vercel.app/
- Orbit OS: an open-source (GPL-3.0) app that sets up Google TV and Android TV from a phone.
  Website https://orbit-os-tv.vercel.app/ · code https://github.com/shivamj56/orbit-os ·
  Google Play https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.shiv.orbit
  Case study (how it works, measured numbers): https://shivamjha.dev/orbit-os.html

## Blog
Shivam's own posts on how his products are built: https://shivamjha.dev/blog/
- What does an AI architect actually do? Five decisions from building NexeraAI and Clonix (17 Nov 2026): where AI
  goes and where it doesn't, grounding models in real data, several providers behind one client, structured output,
  and an error instead of a made-up answer. https://shivamjha.dev/blog/what-does-an-ai-architect-do.html
- How I built NexeraAI, an AI career platform built on real job listings (17 Nov 2026): jobs imported from eight
  sources, duplicates removed, résumés read, and one AI client for Groq, Gemini and OpenAI that shows an error instead
  of a made-up result. https://shivamjha.dev/blog/how-i-built-nexeraai.html
- How Clonix turns a website into design tokens for Cursor, Claude Code and Windsurf (17 Nov 2026): measuring what a
  visitor sees, giving colours and type roles, and writing CLAUDE.md, Cursor rules, .windsurfrules and Tailwind themes.
  https://shivamjha.dev/blog/clonix-design-tokens-for-ai-editors.html
- A calmer family TV, without the risk: the safety rules behind Orbit OS (17 Nov 2026): the TV is recorded before any
  change, apps are switched off and never deleted, the stock home screen goes off only after Orbit Home has started,
  and undo brings the home screen back first. https://shivamjha.dev/blog/orbit-os-safe-setup-for-family-tvs.html

## Studio
- Sqaron Technologies (https://sqaron.dev/): the product studio Shivam co-founded, India. One team from the first screen
  to the last API call: websites that sell, mobile apps, SaaS and dashboards, AI agents and automation, Chrome
  extensions, backends and APIs. A written plan and a fixed price within 72 hours; 14 days of support after launch.
  Shivam leads product, design and the front end. Shivam's studio page: https://sqaron.dev/shivam-jha/

## Work and hiring
Shivam takes freelance projects as an AI architect and full-stack developer: AI products and LLM features (several
providers behind one client, structured outputs, an error instead of a made-up answer), full-stack web apps (Next.js,
React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL), Chrome extensions, and Android, Flutter and Android TV apps. He is based in
Mumbai and works remotely; Sqaron Technologies joins when a project needs a full team. https://shivamjha.dev/hire.html
